decisions.pick: Leda's own army: Leda, Olympia, Catania, Mu, Guzran, Esmeralda, Inyoni, Buccar
decisions.why: Her Part I nine minus Sirocco: Dance targets (Guzran, Inyoni, Esmeralda), two Physic users and two walls. Their supports are already built.
decisions.alt: Splitting Leda's army across A and B

decisions.pick: All 5 keys this Section: B takes Giant's-Print Fort and Enno Isle, C takes Sand-Shadow Fort and Cougar Woodlands
decisions.why: The Temple of the Diadem opens on Section 4's first day; holding all 5 then means 8 Divine exams in the first week. Heretics' Cave is B's from Section 2.

decisions.pick: A's walls plus Lilian (in A this Section) and Catania from C; C launches
decisions.why: Shenlo dodges and his reinforcements are Pegasi: Lilian's Bow Adept Hit lands, Catania flies down the carriers. C launching keeps A's turn for the remaining nodes.

decisions.pick: Credna's Trial in Section 4; Aurora, Jurah, Smyrnos, then Mars (one of the hard ones) in Section 5; Kalla's last in Section 6
decisions.why: Trials can be retried and have no Game Over, but a Lv 40-something squad loses turns to them now. Credna's is the easiest.
decisions.alt: Each Trial right after its request

Divine exams need 100%: Tobias Gauntlet/Axe/Sword S, Cai Axe/Spear/Sword S, Nuzzuo Sword S, Theodora Spear S

Heretics' Cave key first if Section 2 missed it

Pick 5 Angelica at Starbirth Garden (Salacia Posthouse); Aurora asks once time passes

detail: Both rare, vegetables. Monoceros rolls Paired Healing (Nydine) or Paired Miracle (Hong Hua); Ferghanan rolls Canto

Key of the Diadem on Enno Isle (last opening of the path)

Deliver it to Credna, then talk to him again: The Nameless becomes the Shining Spear
